<\STATESEP>theory GenSimpleSystem

begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{ssec:procsys}Generated System Theory\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{sssec:procsystypes}Types\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym component = "(channel, component_state) comp"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym lstate = "component_state local_state"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym gstate = "(inst, channel, component_state) global_state"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:procsysuntrusted}Untrusted Components\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Client_untrusted :: "(Client_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> component"
where
  "Client_untrusted ch \<equiv>
    LOOP (
      UserStep
    \<squnion> ArbitraryRequest (ch Client_s)
    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Client_s))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  Echo_untrusted :: "(Echo_channel \<Rightarrow> channel) \<Rightarrow> component"

  "Echo_untrusted ch \<equiv>
    LOOP (
      UserStep

    \<squnion> ArbitraryResponse (ch Echo_s))"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{ssec:procsysinst}Component Instances\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  client_untrusted :: component

  "client_untrusted \<equiv> Client_untrusted (\<lambda>c. case c of Client_s \<Rightarrow> simple)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  echo_untrusted :: component

  "echo_untrusted \<equiv> Echo_untrusted (\<lambda>c. case c of Echo_s \<Rightarrow> simple)"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsubsection \<open>\label{sssec:procsysgs}Initial State\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>definition
  gs\<^sub>0 :: gstate
where
  "gs\<^sub>0 p \<equiv> case trusted p of Some s \<Rightarrow> Some s | _ \<Rightarrow>
